annotations.title: Statute article as of a given date

description:
Article of a French code or statute, as in force on a date (default: today). `code`: abbreviation ("CT", "cc"), name ("code du travail"), LEGITEXT or statute ("loi 91-647", "loi du 1er juillet 1901"); list: about(topic="codes"). European texts: "CEDH" (protocols: num="P1-1"), "CHARTE_UE", "TUE", "TFUE"; EU acts in force: "RGPD", "directive 93/13", "UE-<CELEX>" (latest French consolidation). To cite an older decision, pass its date: the article is served as it stood then. `view="versions"`: its history; `view="map"`: its wordings, citing texts and implementing orders. `etat` and `note` flag a possible lag behind Légifrance; `info_numero`, a renumbering (former CC 1382 is 1240 since 2016). `num` also accepts a LEGIARTI (then `code` may be omitted). Without `num`, code="LEGITEXT…" (outside the codes) returns the whole text, 120 articles per page (`suite`: offset=…).

Examples: get_law_article(code="RGPD", num="6"); get_law_article(code="code civil", num="1382", date="2015-06-01")

code.description: abbreviation, code name ("code du travail"), LEGITEXT or statute ("loi 91-647", "loi du 1er juillet 1901"); list: about(topic="codes"); also "CEDH" (protocols: num="P1-1"), "CHARTE_UE", "TUE", "TFUE"; EU secondary law in force: "UE-<CELEX>", "RGPD", "DSA", "directive 93/13".
code.title: Code

date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD (optional; if absent, the version in force). With the date of a decision, the article is served as it stood on that date.
date.title: Date

fallback_current.description: date before the first version: false = error `not_in_force_at_date` (`premiere_version`, `ancien_numero`); true = current text flagged `hors_date`.
fallback_current.title: Fallback Current

num.description: article number ("1128", "L1152-1") or "LEGIARTI…"; empty with code="LEGITEXT…" outside the codes: whole text, 120 articles per page.
num.title: Num

view.description: text (default: the article) | versions (its successive wordings) | map (texts that created, amended, cite or implement it).
view.title: View

name: get_law_article
